So far it seems clear that there is good trades to be made on some of these older coins that have been around for years, have quite broad distribution, exhausted sell pressure and a lack of immediate attention on any fundamental updates/changes to the value of the token

Compare it to newer things where news is front ran, heavily speculated in advance, positioned for and has a lot of unrealised pnl (at least in relative terms) and even when it isn't the news pumps very quickly, some of these older projects have genuinely been laying out updates for 6-12 months with most the market not paying much attention
